theorems.name: Submission.aal_cfs_integrating_factor_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (I L a P Q : ℝ → ℝ) (R M β : ℝ), β < 1 → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → HasDerivAt I (P t) t) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → ContinuousAt L t) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → 0 ≤ I t) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → (n : ℝ) * I t - t * P t + t * Q t = -L t) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → a t = L t / t ^ (n + 1) / (1 + I t / t ^ n)) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → |a t| ≤ M * t ^ (-β)) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (-∫ u in (0)..s, a u) * (1 + I s / s ^ n)) (Real.exp (-∫ u in (0)..t, a u) * (Q t / t ^ n)) t) ∧ (∀ t ρ : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ρ → ρ < R → Real.exp (-∫ u in (0)..ρ, |a u|) ≤ Real.exp (-∫ u in (0)..t, a u) ∧ Real.exp (-∫ u in (0)..t, a u) ≤ Real.exp (∫ u in (0)..ρ, |a u|))
